newsitem.title: INDIA: Bank of India share issue said oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: Bank of India share issue said oversubscribed.

text.p: State-run Bank of India's initial public offering (IPO) of shares, closing on Friday, has been oversubscribed, merchant bankers to the issue said.
"Till yesterday evening, it was oversubscribed about 1.2 times," said a merchant banker. He said large institutional subscription was expected on Friday, the closing date.
Bank of India is offering 150 million shares at 45 rupees each with the initial application money set at 25 rupees a share. The bank plans to raise 6.75 billion rupees through the issue.
Merchant bankers to the issue include DSP Merrill Lynch, SBI Capital Markets, Kotak Mahindra Capital Company and the Industrial Development Bank of India.
